dog.description_text:
What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I am playful and cute!

I will need daily physical activity to keep me healthy and happy!

A Volunteer Wrote: This playful pup is an absolute joy to hang out with! He pulls to get out of the building but that's because he appears housetrained like a prince; then he's the most wonderful walking companion to the park where he doesn't give other dogs a passing glance. And why would he, when a person is there to offer up treats and snuggles? The volunteers all think he's the sweetest boy and we love his ever-present smile and wagging tail. Please come meet him and give him something to smile about forever!
dog.name: Cuha
